Welcome to Acme Dental

We are a family dental practice serving the greater Austin area since 1998. Our team is led by Dr. Jane Smith, DDS, who has over twenty years of experience in general and cosmetic dentistry.

Call us at (512) 555-0100 to book an appointment, or visit us at 123 Main Street, Austin, TX 78701. We accept most major insurance plans and offer flexible financing for new patients.

Our Services

  • General checkups and cleanings
  • Cosmetic dentistry and whitening
  • Root canals and restorative work
  • Pediatric dentistry
